parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\overrightarrow{PN} = 8\mathbf{i} - 8\mathbf{k}$ B1
$\overrightarrow{PM} = 4\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} - 6\mathbf{k}$ B2,1,0 (Loses 1 mark for each component incorrect)
$\overrightarrow{PN} = -8\mathbf{i} + 8\mathbf{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{PM} = -4\mathbf{i} - 4\mathbf{j} +6\mathbf{k}$ scores 2/3. SC
$\overrightarrow{PN}.\overrightarrow{PM} = 32 + 0 + 48 = 80$ M1 (Evaluates $x_1x_2+y_1y_2+z_1z_2$ for correct vectors or one or both reversed.)
$|PN|\times|PM| = \sqrt{128} \times \sqrt{68} (= 16\sqrt{34})$ M1 (Product of their moduli - may be seen in cosine rule)
$\sqrt{128} \times \sqrt{68} \cos M\hat{P}N = 80$ M1 (All linked correctly.)
Angle $M\hat{P}N = \mathbf{31.0^{\circ}}$ awrt A1 (Answer must come directly from +ve cosine ratio. Cosine rule not accepted as a complete method. Allow $0.540^c$ awrt. Note: Correct answer from incorrect vectors scores A0 (XP))
